decisions.finding: Under initial Vav of ויִּתְפַּלְלוּ, high-resolution preemptive capture demonstrates a crisp, solid horizontal Patah bar spanning 26 pixels wide and 12 pixels tall stamped directly beneath the Vav foot. Clean white paper separates the mark from surrounding ink; matches positive control Patah on the same page. Confirmed printed Patah (U+05B7).

Under initial Vav of ויְהַלְלוּ, high-resolution preemptive capture demonstrates a clear horizontal Patah bar spanning 28 pixels wide directly beneath the Vav stem, followed by clean white paper below. Distinct from competing two-dot Sheva. Confirmed printed Patah (U+05B7).
